hero.title: Hi, I'm Eduardo
hero.subtitle: Software Engineer.
hero.description: Full-stack, specialized in backend applications for high-availability production systems.
hero.contact: Contact me through any of these channels!

about.paragraph1: Hi! My name is Eduardo Fuentes, a Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience designing and developing backend applications for mission-critical systems, working on platform modernization, migration, and integration projects in high-availability environments.
about.paragraph2: My main focus is backend development with Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js (Express and NestJS), applying principles such as SOLID, Clean Architecture, domain-driven design, and solid testing practices to build maintainable and scalable software. Although my specialty is backend, I also have experience building interfaces with React, which lets me collaborate across the full stack and communicate effectively with frontend teams.
about.paragraph3: Throughout my career I've increased the availability and resilience of a critical ChileCompra service through a migration to a decoupled architecture, contributed to a Fast Checkout solution for Ripley, and optimized queries and indexes in databases, significantly reducing response times for critical processes.
about.paragraph4: In my free time I explore new tools and frameworks, and I also create content about technology. My goal is to keep growing into roles where I can contribute not only by writing code but also by designing scalable systems, making architecture decisions, and building products with real impact. If you're interested in collaborating or just want to talk about technology, feel free to reach out.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Public Market | Factory | Ripley
jobs.description:
Design and implementation of backend microservices using Node.js (Express, NestJS) and Java (Spring Boot). Development and consumption of RESTful APIs for integration with internal and external systems. Participation in migrations and modernization of systems towards decoupled architectures. Optimization of queries and data modeling in PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Automated testing with Jest and JUnit under a TDD approach, applying SOLID principles and Clean Architecture.

Key projects: Ripley (creation and migration of microservices for a new digital product), Innovación-Fábrica (end-to-end testing system focused on automation and prompt engineering), ChileCompra - Consultas al Mercado (migration of a critical module) and Registro de Proveedores (optimization and bug fixing in a critical public-sector system).

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Public Market
jobs.description: Development and maintenance of backend microservices in a high-criticality production environment for Public Market / ChileCompra, built with Spring Boot under a modular architecture. Synchronization between transactional databases and replicas in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, ensuring consistency and performance. Review and optimization of serverless functions in AWS. Resolution of critical incidents and continuous improvement of technical standards and documentation.
